findings.title: messages is stored in lockstep with platform and is always platform?.messages — inline the projection at its one reader
findings.description: Session.messages is written at exactly two sites (the constructor and apply), each immediately after platform is set from the same manifest, as manifest.platform?.messages ?? []. It is a projection of platform with one reader (bannerText). Drop the field and read session.platform?.messages ?? [] at the read site.
